name: lanolin
uses: Uses • temporarily protects minor: cuts, scrapes, burns • temporarily protects and helps relieve chafed, chapped or cracked skin and lips • helps prevent and protect from the drying effects of wind and cold weather
otcwarn: Do not use on deep or puncture wounds animal bites serious burns Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days
